methodology: Competitor DOM + Shader + SVG Anatomy Extraction & Skill Synthesis

rules_enforced: Strict WCAG AA/AAA contrast ratios (>= 4.5:1 body, >= 7:1 primary headings)
Tabular numerals (tabular-nums) on all counters, latencies, byte spans, and version numbers
Semantic ARIA roles (tablist, tab, aria-selected, aria-expanded, status) and visible focus-visible outlines
8pt spatial rhythm with hairline 1px structural borders and zero horizontal overflow
Warm archival paper (#FFFFFF / #F5F5F2) and deep carbon ink (#1A1A18 / #121210), never raw #000000
Editorial IBM Plex Serif display headings paired with IBM Plex Sans body and IBM Plex Mono technical metadata
Flat architectural bento grids with crisp 1px borders (#DEDED8 / #C9C9C1) and disciplined radii (4px controls, 14px-18px panels)
Zero static pill clutter — metadata rendered as unboxed inline monospace text with middot (·) or slash (/) separators
Tactile active button compression: active:scale-[0.98] on all interactive controls
Zero-JS smooth height CSS Grid accordions (grid-rows-[0fr] -> grid-rows-[1fr])
Ghost off-screen sizing for zero-layout-shift word rotation and button width stabilization
